description: This Java source file defines the class PhotoDecodeRunnable, which implements image decoding in a background thread for an Android application. It includes an inner interface for callback methods, constants for decode states, and logic for decoding byte arrays into Bitmaps with memory management and thread interruption handling.

classes.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable
classes.description: A Runnable class that decodes image data from a byte array into a Bitmap, managing thread states and memory, used within an Android app for asynchronous image processing.

classes.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable.TaskRunnableDecodeMethods
classes.description: An interface defining callback methods that the PhotoTask class must implement to facilitate communication with PhotoDecodeRunnable.

methods.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runnable with a reference to the PhotoTask implementing callback methods.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the image decoding process, manages thread state, handles memory errors, and updates the PhotoTask with the decoding result.
